mcqs.q: What is the difference between mass and weight?
options: Mass and weight are the same thing, just expressed in different units.
Mass changes with location but weight does not.
They have the same wavelength because both are used for communication.
Mass is the amount of matter (kg); weight is the gravitational force on that mass (N) and depends on g.

mcqs.q: If air resistance is ignored, which falls faster: a heavy ball or a light ball dropped from the same height?
options: Both fall at the same rate because gravitational acceleration is independent of mass.
Heavier objects fall faster than lighter objects because gravity pulls more on them.
Mass changes with location but weight does not.
The lighter ball falls faster because it has less inertia.

mcqs.q: Which has the longer wavelength: microwaves or radio waves?
options: Mass changes with location but weight does not.
They have the same wavelength because both are used for communication.
Microwaves, because they are used in 'big' devices like radar.
Radio waves — they sit at the longest-wavelength end of the EM spectrum.
